Let me trade: accept the exclusivity field narrowing but push for uni_owns_option_to_assign instead of option_to_licence.

I can change at most two fields. Let me change ip to uni_owns_option_to_assign and keep exclusivity at 18 months or accept 12 months. I'll trade: accept 12 months exclusivity for uni_owns_option_to_assign.
